info.title: ShopFloor Twin MES API
info.description: Read-only API of the MES (Phases 4 and 5): equipment with current state, state intervals, telemetry series, shift totals, the plant clock, OEE per hour and shift, shift instances, reason codes, downtime records and the loss Pareto. No authentication yet (Phase 7); bound to loopback by default. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. Push: WebSocket at /api/v1/ws (see docs/api/realtime.md).

type.description: Always about:blank: the status says it all

Problem.description: An error (RFC 9457 problem details), served as application/problem+json

404.description: Unknown equipment, work center, metric, shift or route

get.summary: State intervals overlapping a time range
get.description: The stored pieces (each inside one UTC hour and one shift) are merged back into whole intervals and clipped to the range. Per shift, use /shifts/{date}/{shift}/totals.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range (inclusive), ISO 8601

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range (exclusive), ISO 8601; at most 7 days after `from`

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An id from master data

truncated.description: True when the range held more pieces than one response takes: intervals that may continue beyond the limit are left out; request again with from = next

next.description: Where to continue when truncated (null otherwise); intervals before it are complete

start.description: Start, clipped to the requested range

end.description: End, clipped to the requested range

provisional.description: May still change: the piece ends after the last time settled by the machine’s own facts (the open interval, or one behind an open sequence gap); false once its epoch is closed

intervalStart.description: Where the whole interval starts (may be before `from`)

startSeq.description: The fact that opened it; null for an anchor

intervals.description: State intervals, the stored hour and shift pieces merged back, by start

get.summary: Time per state in one shift, per equipment and epoch

parameters.name: equipment
parameters.description: Only this equipment

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Shift date (the day the shift starts, Istanbul)

parameters.name: shift
parameters.description: Shift id from the shift pattern, for example A

provisionalMs.description: The part of `ms` that may still change: pieces ending after the last time settled by the machine’s own facts (no open sequence gap below), in an epoch not yet closed. 0 for a completed bucket

revision.description: How often the bucket changed after it was final (a late fill after a gap incident, or a late fact of a closed epoch); 0 while unchanged. The same for every state of an (equipment, epoch)

incidents.description: Sequence-gap incidents of the machine’s device stream over the bucket’s final hours; the same for every state of an (equipment, epoch)

get.summary: OEE of an equipment or work center per hour or shift bucket
get.description: Computed on read (ADR-0021): availability, performance, quality and OEE as exact fractions and four-decimal strings, with inputs, totals and losses. A work center sums its machines' inputs. Shift buckets are whole shifts; no-shift stretches are clipped to the range. `final` once nothing that can still arrive changes the bucket.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: An equipment, or a work center (the sums of its machines’ inputs)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Equipment or work center id

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: UTC hours, or shift buckets (whole shifts)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range (inclusive), ISO 8601

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range (exclusive), ISO 8601; at most 7 days after `from` for hours, 31 for shifts

parameters.name: epoch
parameters.description: Device epoch (run) to read; default: per machine the newest with data in the range

key.description: The hour start (ISO 8601 UTC) or the shift key (`2026-10-12/A`, `no-shift`)

shiftKey.description: The shift bucket the bucket lies in

start.description: Start of the bucket (a no-shift bucket is clipped to the range)

members.description: The machines summed, each with the device epoch read (the newest by default)

stateMs.description: Time per state, every state (0 when absent)

stops.description: Stopped pieces read (each with its whole interval length)

decimal.description: Rounded half-up to four decimals, integer arithmetic only

decimal.description: Rounded half-up to four decimals, integer arithmetic only

oee.description: (ideal × good) / (PBT × produced); 0 when nothing was produced; null when PBT = 0 or anomaly

provisional.description: An open Stopped interval below the threshold counts as a micro-stop for now

microStopMs.description: Stopped intervals below the threshold (part of APT)

idealMs.description: Σ ideal cycle ms × produced count

unplanned.description: Cycles of the unscheduled no-shift bucket, kept out of P and Q

speed.description: APT − micro-stops − ideal time; negative when P > 1

decimal.description: Rounded half-up to four decimals, integer arithmetic only

losses.description: Inside planned busy time, in ms; null when PBT = 0

final.description: Nothing that can still arrive changes it: every hour final in equipment, both hourly aggregates refreshed through it, no Stopped interval still being classified, every member complete

provisionalMs.description: Time in pieces that may still change

revision.description: How often one of its hours changed after it was final (the highest)

incidents.description: Distinct sequence-gap incidents over its hours

items.description: OEE of one equipment or work center over one hour or shift bucket

get.summary: Availability loss by reason and micro-stops by cause
get.description: Own and external availability loss by reason from the downtime records, micro-stops (performance loss) by cause from the Stopped intervals below the threshold, all clipped to the range, without a row limit: the sums equal the OEE losses. Epoch: the one given, else the newest with data (one for all machines of a work center).
